root: ^Long ago by the northern mountains rose the small village of Gunhildr. It was merely built for the miners so they could have a roof other than the cave ceiling.

^However one day, when they went to dig, they found… something. Where there had previously been a mine now were corridors of cobblestone that led ever deeper into the mountain. It wasn’t long before the miners started getting drawn to the cold uncaring halls.
^At first, the adventurers came back with glory and treasure, yet seldom spoke of what else they saw. All except one thing. ”Agathol”, the word that would become its name.

^Word quickly spread of its riches and Günhildr’s size and influence followed suit. Thousands of explorers flocked to the once unremarkable town in search for what could be found within Agathol’s depths, hoping they too would be one of the lucky ones.
^It's been over 100 years since then and of those who never did return, my son is now among them.
^And I need to know what happened to him.
